concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create ONE polished landscape brand identity exploration board for a Brazilian independent electoral and demographic data observatory. This is a visual proposal for choosing the brand, with professional graphic design, not a website screenshot.
Concept 01: "OLHAR". Brand name exactly "Mente Eleitoral". Tagline exactly "Um olhar único sobre votação e população". Title in small type "01 / OLHAR".
Design a distinctive simple optical symbol: two elegant open curved brackets form an abstract eye, central pupil built from three compact rectangular data columns with a clearly readable silhouette. Subtle M/E visual rhythm, but prioritize a beautiful recognizable mark. No literal brain, no surveillance camera, no political iconography.
Palette art direction: deep midnight navy #13283F, mineral teal #147D85, warm paper #F4F1E9; navy is primary and teal accent. Typography: refined contemporary humanist sans, confident "Mente" and lighter "Eleitoral", excellent Portuguese typography.
Layout: generous warm paper background, large hero horizontal logo and tagline in upper 55%; lower 45% orderly graphic samples: same logo white on navy panel, same standalone mark as square favicon on teal, four coordinated outlined navigation icons representing results (bar chart), territory (folded map), population (two people), sources (document). Include discreet palette chips. Show same actual symbol consistently in every variant. Keep icons and typography clear, no tiny explanatory paragraphs. All graphic elements flat vector-like, no gradients, no shadows, no mockup photography, no 3D, no data numbers. Symbol must also work in monochrome and at small size. Original graphic identity, do not imitate known brands. Balanced art-directed visual board, crisp edges, generous margins. Only text requested above plus small labels "Resultados", "Território", "População", "Fontes" under icons.

Use case: logo-brand.
Create ONE polished landscape visual brand identity exploration board for a Brazilian independent observatory of electoral results, population and socioeconomic territorial context. Concept 02: "CONEXÕES". This is a graphic design presentation for choosing a brand.
Exact headline small "02 / CONEXÕES". Exact brand name "Mentalidade Eleitoral". Exact tagline "Um olhar único sobre votação e população".
Design an ORIGINAL compact abstract symbol suggesting thoughtful connections: two interlocking rounded geometric paths, three or four large nodes, negative space creates a subtle M and an open network. Bold strong silhouette, no thin circuit maze, no literal anatomical brain, no light bulb, no AI robot. Analytical but human, no claim to read voters' thoughts. Must remain recognizable at favicon size.
Palette: deep aubergine #392F50 primary, iris #7966AD accent, pale lilac #E9E3F0 and ivory #F8F5EF. Typography: elegant contemporary sans with softly rounded details; lay out long name elegantly across two lines "Mentalidade" then "Eleitoral", carefully kerned and prominent, tagline legible.
Layout generous ivory field, upper 55% hero mark and two-line wordmark and tagline. Lower section organized examples: same logo in white on aubergine rectangle, standalone symbol on rounded-square lilac app icon, and four matching simple stroke navigation icons: result bar chart, folded territory map, population two people, source document. Labels exactly "Resultados", "Território", "População", "Fontes". Include small palette swatches. This is a single coherent identity repeated in light/dark/icon applications, not a collage of unrelated logos. Flat clean vector-like design, no 3D, no textures, no shadows, no gradients, no charts with invented values, no flags or party symbols. Beautiful proportions, broad margins, warm intellectual credible tone.

Use case: logo-brand.
Create ONE polished landscape graphic identity concept board for a neutral Brazilian electoral and population data observatory, exploring a different identity direction from optical symbols. Concept 03: "TERRITÓRIOS".
Exact small heading "03 / TERRITÓRIOS". Main brand name exactly "Mente Eleitoral". Tagline exactly "Um olhar único sobre votação e população".
Original logo: a compact modular geometric monogram M, made of four broad connected tessellated tile forms, evocative of adjacent territories seen on a map and the diversity of a population. Strong architectonic graphic construction and clever negative space; simple outline silhouette, no actual Brazil map, no eye, no brain, no electoral checkmark. It should feel like a civic editorial publication and a cartographic data tool.
Palette: deep petrol #103F4C primary, muted terracotta #BD7159 accent, oat #F1E7D7 and white #FFFDFA; dark petrol dominates, terracotta is limited. Wordmark typography refined contemporary editorial serif, strong and legible with small bracketed serifs, understated sophistication, ample spacing. Icon family in matching confident geometric monoline strokes.
Composition upper 55% generous white space and large hero logo with symbol beside prominent name and tagline; lower 45% clean presentation row: identical white logo on dark petrol panel, monogram/favicon in rounded square, four outlined navigation icons with labels exactly "Resultados", "Território", "População", "Fontes": bar chart, folded map, two people, source document. Small palette swatches. Match symbol geometry exactly between versions. Brand artwork, not a real app screenshot. No real or fictional electoral figures or data, no gradients, shadows, paper texture, 3D, campaign posters, party logos, stars or flags. High-end flat vector-like logo design, crisp typographic craft.
